title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
statement: nums has length n and every value lies between 1 and n. Some values appear twice and some not at all. Return every value in 1..n that is absent, in any order.
hints: A HashSet of what is present, then a sweep of 1..n, is the direct solution.
For O(1) extra space, use the array itself as the marker: value v means index v-1 is present.
Walk the array negating nums[abs(v)-1]. Afterwards, any index still holding a positive value was never marked.
